The '''Unifiers''', also called '''Scarlet Riders''' and '''Scarlet Runners''' by [[Kerra Holt]], were red-uniformed [[Sith acolyte/Legends|Sith adepts]] that served the [[Dyarchy]], a [[Sith/Legends|Sith]] state that existed in the [[Grumani sector/Legends|Grumani sector]] during the [[Republic Dark Age]]. The Unifiers specialized in the use of [[Mind trick/Legends|Force persuasion]] and were less skilled at other [[Force power/Legends|Force powers]]. They received orders from the [[Krevaaki]] [[Sith Lord/Legends|Sith Lord]] [[Saaj Calician]] via a network of telepathic [[Celegian/Legends|Celegians]], and used their [[The Force/Legends|Force]] abilities to create a haze of [[Mind trick/Legends#Force persuasion|Force persuasion]] that numbed the minds of the Dyarchy's non-[[Force-sensitive/Legends|Force-sensitive]] populations, keeping their subjects fully under Dyarchy control.
